name: search_conversations
description: Search previous conversation history for a specific TOPIC or KEYWORD. Use ONLY when user asks to find conversations about a specific subject, like: 'did I ask about Bitcoin before?', 'when did I mention Flask?', 'show conversations about reminders'. Requires a 'query' parameter. For temporal queries like 'what was my last question?' or 'what did I just ask?', use 'get_recent_conversations' instead (no query needed, returns by time).

query.description: What to search for in previous conversations (searches both user queries and responses)

limit.description: Maximum number of conversations to return (default: 10)
